title: Event
description: An immutable, append-only record of a protocol state change. See docs/protocol/16-event-model.md.

missionId.description: The mission this event is scoped to, if any. Org-scoped mutations (e.g. Participant, Capability, Policy) have no mission to attach to.

subjectType.description: The kind of resource this event is about (e.g. 'mission', 'activity', 'participant').
